parsed.name: SUN RPC UDP客户端组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于通过 UDP 实现 SUN RPC 客户端/服务端通信，借助端口映射器发现服务端口，并完成 XDR 数据的打包、解包与远程过程调用。它适用于实验系统中需要访问基于 RPC 的网络服务或仪器配套软件的场景。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component that implements SUN RPC client/server communication over UDP, uses the port mapper to discover service ports, and performs XDR packing, unpacking, and remote procedure calls. It is used in lab systems that need to access RPC-based network services or instrument-associated software.
